title: What will be the top AI model on Oct 31, 2026? gemini-4-argon-high
rules: If gemini-4-argon-high is the top-ranked AI model on Oct 31, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: If two models are tied under Rank (UB), then the model with the highest Arena Score will win. If two models are still tied after that, then the model with the most votes will win. If two models are still tied after that, the model that was released earlier will win. Important information: When checking the source for this market, check the 'Remove Style Control' toggle.

blind.reasoning: Gemini 4 Argon was released October 13, 2026 and is reported to be #1 on the LMArena Text Arena, and only about 2.5 weeks remain before resolution. A newly crowned leader usually holds that long. Risks are that the ranking differs with style control removed, a rival launches before October 31, or the exact 'high' variant is not the one at the top.
blind.falsifier: A different model (e.g., a new Claude, GPT-6 or Grok release, or Claude Opus 5.5) shows as Rank 1 with a higher Arena Score on the LMArena text leaderboard with style control removed on Oct 31, 2026.

final.reasoning: The market midpoint (0.735) is essentially the same as my independent estimate (0.72), so the price confirms rather than changes my view. The gap is smaller than the 0.71–0.76 spread, so there is no edge on either side.
